import sys,json,pathlib,hashlib,subprocess,tempfile
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).parent/'round5-snapshot'
sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
import laps,collect
out={}
fixture=[{'date':str(i),'lap_number':lap,'message':msg} for i,(lap,msg) in enumerate([(10,'SAFETY CAR DEPLOYED'),(12,'RED FLAG'),(15,'GREEN LIGHT - PIT EXIT OPEN'),(40,'SAFETY CAR DEPLOYED'),(44,'SAFETY CAR IN THIS LAP')])]
out['redFlagFixture']={'messages':fixture,'actual':laps.sc_laps(fixture),'expectedOnsets':[10,40]}
out['decisionTargetLoss']={t:collect.parse_decision('Decision Drop of 3 grid positions '+t+'. Reason Causing a collision.') for t in ['for this race','for the next race in which the driver participates','for the next Sprint']}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=root.parent) as td:
    def archived(*p):return str(pathlib.Path(td).joinpath(*p))
    def read_json(p):return json.loads(pathlib.Path(p).read_text())
    def write_json(p,x,**kw):pathlib.Path(p).parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);pathlib.Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(x))
    write_json(archived('laps','gd01.json'),{'race':{'laps':{'AAA':[[1]]}}})
    write_json(archived('races','gd01.json'),{'race':{'pace':{'AAA':.1},'paceCtx':{'AAA':.9},'paceSe':{'AAA':.2},'pacePool':{'AAA':.9}}})
    write_json(archived('telemetry','laps','gd01.json'),{'sessions':{'R':{'present':True}}})
    oldff=laps.with_ff
    laps.with_ff=lambda canon,ff:{**canon,'quality':{'ff':{'ok':False}}}
    try:rec=laps.reconcile(archived,read_json,write_json,1)
    finally:laps.with_ff=oldff
    wrote=laps.pool_rounds(archived,read_json,write_json,[1])
    out['pooledQualityRevocation']={'afterReconcile':rec,'poolWrites':wrote,'archiveAfterPool':read_json(archived('races','gd01.json')),'fixture':'real reconcile and pool_rounds; with_ff stub supplies a failed cross-source quality check'}
# Read raw race-control caches without changing them; compare with a parser that explicitly ends open SC state on red.
def red_aware(rc):
    out=[]; active=False
    for m in sorted(rc,key=lambda x:x.get('date') or ''):
        msg=(m.get('message')or'').upper();lap=m.get('lap_number')
        if msg.startswith('SAFETY CAR DEPLOYED') and not active:out.append([lap,None]);active=True
        elif msg.startswith('SAFETY CAR IN THIS LAP') and active:out[-1][1]=lap;active=False
        elif m.get('flag')=='RED' or msg.startswith('RED FLAG'):active=False
    return out
seen=set();diffs=[]
for p in pathlib.Path('C:/Claude memory/F1 Fantasy/cache').glob('of_*.json'):
    if not(p.name.startswith('of_rc_')or p.name.startswith('of_race_control_')):continue
    rc=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));rc=rc.get('data',rc) if isinstance(rc,dict) else rc
    if not isinstance(rc,list):continue
    a=laps.sc_laps(rc);b=red_aware(rc)
    if a!=b:
        key=json.dumps(rc,sort_keys=True)
        if key in seen:continue
        seen.add(key);diffs.append({'cache':p.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'actual':a,'redAware':b,'messages':[{k:m.get(k) for k in ['session_key','date','lap_number','message','flag']}for m in rc if 'SAFETY CAR' in (m.get('message')or'')or m.get('flag')=='RED']})
out['rawCacheRedDifferences']=diffs
inventory=[]
for p in (root/'history/2026/fia').glob('*.json'):
    d=json.loads(p.read_text());docs=[x for x in d.get('docs',[])if collect.PEN_TITLE.search(x.get('title',''))]
    inventory.append({'file':p.name,'decisions':len(docs),'unread':sum('grid'not in x for x in docs),'penalties':[{'title':x.get('title'),'grid':x['grid'],'published':x.get('published'),'url':x.get('url')}for x in docs if x.get('grid')]})
out['fiaInventory']=inventory
start=json.loads((root.parent/'round5-manifest-start.json').read_text());changed=[]
for name,sha in start['hashes'].items():
    p=pathlib.Path('C:/Claude memory/F1 Fantasy')/name
    if not p.exists() or hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=sha:changed.append(name)
out['changedSinceSnapshot']=changed
out['headAtCheck']=subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','safe.directory=C:/Claude memory/F1 Fantasy','-C','C:/Claude memory/F1 Fantasy','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
(root.parent/'round5-python-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items()if k not in ['fiaInventory','rawCacheRedDifferences']},indent=2))
print('raw cache differences:',len(diffs),'FIA decisions:',sum(x['decisions']for x in inventory),'unread:',sum(x['unread']for x in inventory))

const fs=require('fs'),W=require('./round5-snapshot/backtest/walk.js'),E=W.E,Old=require('./round5-previous-engine.cjs');const data=W.asOf(15),g=W.D.schedule.find(x=>x.gd===15),out={};const med=a=>a.sort((x,y)=>x-y)[Math.floor(a.length/2)];
for(const [tag,X] of [['previous',Old],['current',E]]){out[tag]={};for(const mode of ['rank','laps','segments']){X.withSettings({'SIM.raceModel':mode},()=>{const b=X.raceSetup(data,g,{next:true,oddsW:0});X.simulate(b.model,b.circuit,false,1000,5,b.simOpt);const st=[],ss=[];for(let i=0;i<5;i++){let t=performance.now();X.raceSetup(data,g,{next:true});st.push(performance.now()-t);t=performance.now();X.simulate(b.model,b.circuit,false,10000,71+i,b.simOpt);ss.push(performance.now()-t)}out[tag][mode]={setupMs:med(st),finalMs:med(ss)};console.log(tag,mode,out[tag][mode]);});}}fs.writeFileSync(__dirname+'/round5-timings.json',JSON.stringify(out,null,2));
